title: Understand
description: I start by understanding the idea, purpose, audience, and problem that the design needs to solve.

title: Plan
description: I organize the content, structure, and user flow before moving into the visual design.

title: Design
description: I develop the visual direction through layouts, typography, colors, imagery, and interface elements.

title: Refine
description: I review the design, identify what can be improved, and refine the details to make the final result clearer and more polished.

title: Deliver
description: I prepare the final design and make sure it is ready for presentation, development, or actual use.
